# https://strucureo.com/

## Home

Strucureo is an IT services and software development company founded in February 2026. We help startups and small businesses worldwide build custom websites, AI chatbots, ERP systems, and software products — delivered in days, not months.

Our structured 4-step process — Diagnose, Design Options, Build Fast, Launch & Support — ensures practical solutions that reduce ambiguity and ship quickly. Led by Nagaratinam S (Managing Director), Strucureo operates as a remote engineering studio serving clients across the US, UAE, Germany, Russia, and India.

We specialize in custom software development, AI automation, web development, ERP systems, startup MVP development, and cloud support. Our technology stack includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Supabase, and various AI/ML tools.

---

# https://strucureo.com/services

## Services

### Custom Software Development
Purpose-built applications designed for your specific business needs. We build internal portals, customer-facing platforms, and everything in between — delivered in focused sprints.

### Website Development
Conversion-focused marketing sites, landing pages, and product pages built with Next.js for speed, SEO, and trust. We deliver in days, not months.

### AI Chatbot Development
Customer support bots, internal assistants, and AI workflows connected to your documents and escalation paths. We integrate with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI providers.

### ERP & Operations Systems
Custom dashboards and business systems for inventory, orders, roles, and reporting. Streamline your operations with tailored solutions.

### Startup MVP Development
Lean product builds that help founders validate ideas quickly without overbuilding. We focus on core functionality and rapid iteration.

### Automation & Cloud Support
Cloud deployment, CI/CD setup, performance fixes, and monitoring for existing products. We support AWS, Netlify, Vercel, and other platforms.

### Our Process
1. Diagnose: We clarify the business problem, current bottlenecks, users, constraints, and success metrics.
2. Design Options: You receive practical solution paths with tradeoffs around speed, cost, complexity, and long-term scale.
3. Build Fast: We ship in focused milestones, keep scope visible, and avoid unnecessary engineering ceremony.
4. Launch & Support: We help deploy, monitor, document, and improve the system after real users start using it.

## About Strucureo

Strucureo was founded on February 26, 2026, with a vision to build a remote engineering studio that delivers focused, high-quality software solutions without the bloat of traditional agencies.
